note: The 201/1-01 BUNDLE column: what `dispatch.html` ships, per chunk and per source module. Desk measurement, no device — `npm run build -- --base=./ --sourcemap`, then the chunks `dispatch.html` reaches by static import, attributed to sources by walking each chunk's sourcemap (generated bytes between consecutive mapping segments, the same method source-map-explorer uses). Commit-dated 2026-08-09. This is the BEFORE table: nothing is cut here, and step 1/06 is where a cut would be argued. The dead-code half needed the tool fixed first — `apps/dispatch` and `apps/engine-lab` were absent from `knip.json`, so knip reported the console's whole source tree as unused and had never checked it at all; entries added in the same change.

readings.reactIsTheLARGESTthingAMapShips: 173.9 kB of 394.2 kB attributed — 44.1 % — is react-dom, more than the entire engine (139.8 kB) and four times the console's own code (43.2 kB). The console is a 3D map that keeps React out of the frame loop by design, and React is still the biggest thing it downloads. That is a fact for 1/06 to argue with, not a cut: the chrome is React and the seam is deliberate.
readings.theEngineIsALREADYtheSmallerHalf: 139.8 kB, of which `engine.ts` is 44.0 and `hosek-wilkie-data.ts` is 33.4 — a tabulated sky model, 8.5 % of everything attributed, in a surface whose sky is a backdrop. It is the one engine line item whose size is out of proportion to what a top-down map does with it, and the first thing 1/06 should price.
readings.whatAMapShipsFromTheGAME: 5.1 kB `packages/game` (the environment driver and its cloud/sun plugins — the one permitted seam), 3.6 kB `packages/renderware` (the timecyc parser behind it), 2.4 kB `apps/engine-lab` (the synthetic city `?demo=1` builds), and 1.8 kB `apps/web` — the GAME app's camera maths, imported by `apps/dispatch/src/map/map-camera.ts` for `cursorRay`, `forwardFrom`, `dollyStep`, `panStep`. App-to-app is permitted by the boundary lint, and it is still the map depending on the game shell's internals for four functions.
readings.deadCode: One unused export in the console after knip could finally see it: `MARKER_CAPACITY` in `apps/dispatch/src/map/beacons.ts`. The bundle is not carrying dead weight; it is carrying live weight that a map may not need.
readings.whatAPhoneDOWNLOADS: 166.5 kB gzipped over six chunks — against a first-download budget 201 states as 'as large as needed if it caches'. The bundle is not the problem this chain was worried about, and saying so with a number is the point of a before-table.
